description: Markos’s spies have reported that Commander Fassith has been sneaking out of the city at night, once a week. The spies reported seeing her leave messages hidden beneath a stone pillar with strange writings, just outside of the Order Fort near Guild City. The spies can't get close enough to grab the letter, but you can. Find the letter and bring it back to Sir Petyr.
name: A Secretive Commander (MSQ)
completed: Return to Sir Petyr, at The Twins village, to deliver the letter you have gathered.
